hard_points: Very dense indicator text with unusual definitional reasoning (覆盖率, per-10k measures, 绿道密度); several items need hidden totals (population, built-up area), a computability judgement, and a multi-step 综合判断.

Dense two-paragraph education text, no tables. Options 1 apart, 多多少倍 trap, base-period per-unit with several traps, near-5% and near-12000 thresholds, an ambiguous category count and a 几项 question. Very hard.
副省级 cumulative-period table: Q4 subtracts two precise base values, Q3 多多少倍 trap, Q5 亿/万 unit and logic traps, Q1 average change with unit conversion. Hardest passage here.
Computation-heavy: yearly totals built from four columns, five-year ratios, 万亿元/万公顷→万元/亩 conversion with a borderline 2018 value, and close growth comparisons. Hard passage.

Dense text of minutes and participation rates, no table; every question needs a concept (hidden residual, participant average, mixture/cross method, set overlap, weekday weighting). Hardest provincial target.
Chart gives daily averages, so most items need month-length conversions; near-threshold comparisons (Sep, 69.95%) and an ambiguous counting statement make Q5 a trap. Hard.

Survey pie/bar of respondent shares; four of five items are set-overlap logic (一定/至少/可能/exact-count traps) rather than arithmetic. Q3 conditional minimum and Q4 '说不清' range are classic error sources. Hard.

Short text but logic-heavy: 达标/超标 complements, percentage points turned into days, a novel target-allocation problem and an inference item with a growth-rate-vs-increment trap. Reasoning over arithmetic.
Two dual-axis charts, 10 cities, four series; many divisions with borderline cases, a derived seats-per-screening statement and occupancy-rate modelling; mid-late 国考 passage.

Dense 25-row table with monthly and cumulative columns; every item needs calculation: two base-periods with close options, reverse mixed growth, 16-row counting, and a four-statement count with a 多…倍 trap.

Monthly total chart plus cumulative industrial chart; three items require converting cumulative data to monthly or prior-year quarterly values, precision-sensitive differences, and 环比/同比 logic. Computation-heavy.
Every item needs real computation: unit conversions (亿元/万吨, ‰), near-threshold calls (10.4%, 75.95%), residual pie share chained with growth, and line-chart matching; distractors mirror common slips.
Two dual-axis monthly charts; several items need hidden 2016 values via base-period, a line-shape matching item and unit conversion. Strong traps for directly using displayed 2017 data.

Hard. Dense 12-row table mixing single-month and cumulative data; 环比 derivation, base-weight mixed growth with midpoint boundary trap, two-base subtraction, reasoning-heavy 综合 option. Row-misreading traps throughout.

Trap-dense: 亿个→万亿千瓦时 conversion, a cumulative chart that must be differenced (3.7 decoy), scanning 31 provinces for top five, and a 综合 where misreading the cumulative chart or units makes wrong options look true.
Two cumulative-data charts force repeated differencing; Q3 hinges on the 累计 vs 当月 mixed-growth insight; Q5 has a same-shape distractor needing magnitudes. Hardest of the 国考 targets.
Concept traps dominate: January 环比 needs derived Dec-2016, '变化最大' means increment not rate, derivability logic for ②③, plus a residual mixed-growth sign check.
Text-only with mostly negative growth rates; negative average-rate trap, multi-step part growth, negative increment, and '0 items' answer needing mixing logic. Harder than average.

Key quantities are implicit (网民 = 用户 ÷ 比重). Q4 needs six derived totals and near-tied growth comparisons; Q3 hides a rounding trap (bar difference vs rate-derived increment). Most computation-heavy passage of the set.
A severe perspective-reversal plus absolute-value trap where every wrong combination is an option, a two-sided increment projection, and two look-alike totals (上海 vs 上海口岸).

Moderate-hard. Cumulative bar-line chart drives four items: monthly values by differencing, cumulative base subtraction, single-month growth needing two cumulative bases—classic error-prone setup. Text adds July vs 1-7月 confusion.
Survey with two sample sizes and multi-select data: Q3 base-change trap (percent up but count down), 容斥 minimum overlap and multi-select averaging; material spread over a table and two charts.
Two clear charts, but a period-counting trap (2011初–2018末), eight growth checks, unit conversion and a 1%-close per-park comparison inside the judgment item; average 国考 opening passage.
Dense text of 6-7 digit numbers and look-alike figures; most questions chain base-period steps (增速增加39个百分点, 比例增加4.86个百分点) with year and share-change traps. Calculation-heavy.

Moderate-hard. Dense numeric text spanning 2021-2023; negative-increment sign trap, base-period share and sum, interval base needing the 2021 figure, and derivability hinging on '两年平均增长' and contribution-rate concepts.
One clean table, but most items need summing 3-6 provinces then judging against tight thresholds (30%, 4.5x, 10%); Q4 hides a 万公斤 vs 万吨 unit trap. Moderate-hard for a first passage.
Moderate-hard. Dense text listing many industries with growth rates; four-way increment ordering, compound-growth year count with adjacent options, and a 综合 built on sign and '多…倍' wording traps.
Dense text of near-identical figures as the last passage; negative-rate interval growth with 降幅扩大 wording, bank-only 2021 base-period, and options built on precise lures (8.85%, 3427 vs 3393).

Short text but traps everywhere: deriving 2014 rate from '降幅扩大', 2014 surplus needing two base periods with the 2015 value as an option, vague '基本保持上年水平' in the inference question; GK population depresses rates.
纯文字长材料定位成本高；混合增长、比重反推增速、负增长量作差层层递进，Q5为0项且③紧贴40%，易误判。
长文字数据密集需定位；Q2需作差求基期，Q3平均数增速有相减陷阱，Q4复合增长选项密集，Q5饼图差异细微。
Two charts plus text with several base-period traps; Q5 combines inclusion-exclusion, chart scanning and share-vs-growth logic. Moderate-hard.
Text mixes cumulative stock and 2022 additions; three items require backing out 2021 values or mixture reasoning, with distractors built from using 2022 stock or counts only.
累计 monthly data with two growth lines: Q1 and Q3 need base-period recovery on two series with close options, Q2 tests the 当月 vs 累计 growth insight. The regional questions are easy.

All dense text, no chart; most items need a derived base (2020 totals, population from urbanization rate). Q5's time-range trap with an exactly matching number is very attractive while the true option looks approximate.
Built on the 两年平均增长 concept (Q1, Q4), plus a residual mixed-growth and a close increment comparison; long table to scan.
Three-part material (two dual-axis charts plus text). Unit pitfalls (亿人次, 万个), growth comparisons on coarse two-decimal series, and a seven-year check in Q5 make it slow and error-prone.

Text needing implied quantities: import from total−export with negative mixed growth, base-period share, and recognizing that 拉动 makes Guangdong's base derivable. Count-type final item punishes conceptual gaps.

All-text material crowded with similar volume, value and share figures, so locating data is slow; unit-price and mixed-growth logic, plus a comprehensive item whose decoy matches numerically but carries the wrong currency.
Nearly every question needs base-period work on a dense table; tight options, MoM back-calculation, pie-chart matching, and an inference question with a 亿→万 unit trap and near-threshold comparisons.
Dense text-only material where most shares and growth rates appear only as '高于…个百分点' differences; every question needs derivation, plus share change, product growth and a magnitude trap in Q5.
Long dense text with many look-alike figures (营收, 出口交货值, USD exports, 200-firm subset). 拉动增长 and profit-margin change need multi-step work; Q5 hides a 降幅-低 direction trap. Moderately hard.
Single decimal-heavy table; nothing conceptually hard, but many multi-digit additions and subtractions, 万亿/亿 switches, and a laborious increment-shape question late in the GK section.
Short text, but nearly every item needs base-period reconstruction (同比下降, 恢复至2019年%) chained across steps; Q4 needs three precise divisions with tight options. Calculation-heavy.
Long table plus text. Concept items (增长贡献率, profit via margin) and a judgement item whose tempting option C fails only on a subtle time mismatch, alongside a unit trap.
Clean table plus bar-line chart; moderate work: base-period year for a cumulative sum, unit-price growth, 24-month average. Traps: omitting 2012, 亿/万亿 units, a close 450 threshold.

Table plus stacked bar chart; most items need several growth-rate computations with 6-point option gaps, reading stacked labels, catch-up year logic; 综合 hides an equal-increment trap and the correct answer is last.
Short text plus labelled line chart; little arithmetic but concept-heavy: 拉动 back-out, average-growth precision, cumulative-vs-monthly growth logic, and judging derivability using chart data.

Dense two-level table (quarter vs March, volume vs value, growth). Three items need growth algebra: reverse mixed growth, base-period difference with sign/unit trap, ratio-of-growths where the subtraction shortcut fails.
文字+12个月堆积柱图，单位亿/万混用；Q1隔年表述绕，Q5四项都要读图计算且有临界项，耗时。

Text + 7-year table. Q3 needs derived 'other institutions' with an all-average trap, Q4 seven borderline ratio checks, Q5 four statements with unit/derived values. Moderate 国考 passage, no single brutal item.
Moderate. Text-only material; items need last-year growth backed out from '提高/降低…个百分点', base shares and sign-aware increments; pie options A/B nearly identical. Traps reuse current-year figures.
Long text with structure ratios: reverse interval growth, share-based base and growth, contribution rate, and the classic '多4倍' wording trap inside a count-type item.
Clean table but concept-trap heavy: '变化量' absolute vs signed, 3.8 threshold equal to naive estimate, 拉动 vs growth, 万艘 vs 艘, and a per-ship ratio that is exactly unchanged.
Clean labelled charts, light arithmetic, but decisive traps: hidden base-period increment for 2011, simple-vs-weighted average price, and volume×price unit insight for amount.

Busy four-series quarterly line chart; annual totals must be built from quarters; Q3 hinges on base-period convention with every variant offered; Q5 has a near-tie growth comparison. Last passage of the paper.
Short text plus dual-axis chart; base-period and per-event-average items with listed traps (2024 vs 2023 data, 倍数 −1, near-equal 2021/2022 averages). Arithmetic modest; no very hard item.
Dense text with relational figures (高于…个百分点) to decode; base-period averages; the pie item needs full 2018 share reconstruction against a decoy pie of 2023 shares.

Two dense 10-city tables. Laborious ranking recount with close pairs, contribution-rate concept needing base-period increase, average growth from increments, table-choice trap in pie. Moderate; time-consuming more than tricky.
Rate-heavy text where every past figure comes from 增速回落 wording. Interval growth with cross-term trap, and an abstract derivability count that many misjudge (② looks underivable).
Dense text full of 降幅扩大/收窄 and 增速提升 phrasing; a two-year base calculation with traps on both sides, and a combination item hinging on textual inference plus a 美元/元 unit trap.
Dense historical text with many year-end figures. Q1's base-year trap (1980年末) catches most users and Q3 needs creative use of two average-increment figures; the rest are direct lookups.
Short text with clear numbers; standard increment, share-change and projection work. Difficulty sits in Q5 derivability check (all four) and two-part increments. Moderate.

Convention traps dominate: 2017-2021 年均 uses 2016 base with every misreading offered; 综合 hinges on '2016-2021逐年增加' needing absent 2015 data while the 25.9倍 statement is true; 电视/广播 and 十三五 definitions.
Dense table with month/cumulative and 同比/环比 columns; questions mix periods (Apr vs last May, 1–3月, 1–4月). Listed traps for YoY/MoM, 多N倍 and current-vs-base share.

One 15-row table; reading easy but many rows. Counting with negatives, an exact 15-number sum, compound catch-up year, and a final item needing two top-3 rankings with near-tied values (8.71 vs 8.63).
Two 10-month bar charts with paired labels; many additions, production/sales confusion, share change with negative growth, near-30% threshold. Tedious rather than tricky.
Dense numeric text; mixed growth with tight options, novel matching between near-identical pies, multi-step base-period monthly average, 钢材/铜材 reading trap; last 国考 passage, so many guess.
Pure text with a custom 投入收益率 definition. Q2–Q4 need formula manipulation (weighted mix, rate-to-cost inversion, chained comparison); Q5's answer is a subtle scope change, not a number.

Moderate. Two tables with near-identical monthly values; precise division, very close ratio comparison, cumulative-to-monthly differencing with tight comparison and percentage trap. One easy sum-ratio item offsets.
Single cumulative-monthly table; nearly every item needs differencing cumulatives or base-period conversion of 7-digit numbers; traps around cumulative vs single period.
表格部分简单直观；难点集中在Q1需从'百分点'表述还原上年增速，再做两年两量比值，表述绕、易错。
Concept-driven rather than calculation-driven: stock vs flow of 公积金余额 (Q1, Q5-D), a tempting 新开户 subtraction trap (Q5-C), and a double trap in Q4 (share direction plus 多几倍). Q2–Q3 are routine.

Large 12-row table; Q1 and Q5 need exhaustive row-by-row comparisons including a near tie, costing time and inviting miscounts. Other items are standard calculations with clear options. Moderately hard.
Single clean table, but every question needs many row calculations; Q3 has 14 growth checks across two years and Q4 a fairly close ratio ranking; few genuine traps.

Two tidy 5-year tables; arithmetic simple. Points lost on pie discrimination (production vs consumption), a near-boundary average, and option A where the negative 2022 gap must count in absolute terms.
Text-only, number-dense electricity passage with nested 含 items. Two-step base-period share, two-base difference, and a precise division with options 5 apart; standard concepts but calculation-heavy.
Text-only, mixing 市辖区 and 全省 data; multi-step base-period growth, an average-change item and semantic traps ('多4倍多', scope mismatch) in Q5. Moderate content, M3 position adds time pressure.
Table gives absolute increments instead of rates; near-identical row names (运输工具总数 vs 进出境总数) are exploited in the 能推出 item; the 1/9 threshold comparison needs precision.
Text-only, number-dense passage; figures must be hunted across paragraphs; ring and two-step base periods; count item with 多N倍 and base-period traps.

Very number-dense banking text slows locating. Calculations are standard (mixed growth, average growth, 环比 rates from decreases); the killer is the 现金 vs 非现金 wording trap where the computation misleadingly confirms option A.

Text-only, half-year vs three-quarter data; base-period subtraction, negative increments and margin-based profit growth all need two-step reasoning; 综合 has a pp-shift trap and a near-threshold product. Moderate.
Long dense text with dozens of similar figures; locating data costs time. Traps: base of '少百分之几', inclusion-exclusion minimum, and direction of '净增量减少18.5万'.
Text plus 9-quarter chart/table; several hidden derivations (revenue = R&D ÷ ratio), quarter-vs-month and 环比-vs-同比 traps, and a heavy comprehensive item with a near-threshold base-period statement.

Two combo charts with 48 numbers. Items require reaching back a year through 同比 (2018年1月, 2018年6月), a 0.5 boundary count, and a tedious 综合 of month-by-month counts. Strong decoys from using 2019 values directly.
Simple text and bar-line chart, but options are tight (Q1 within 1%, Q2 2-point steps); Q4/Q5 need several divisions, compound growth and two-period share estimates.
Dense population text plus a 13-row table. Q2 needs the birth/death-rate definitions; Q4 has a near tie and a scope trap. The rest are spaced-option estimates. Medium.
Two plain charts. Hurdles: the 十三五/十四五 spans, a projection only 82 away from a trap, a contribution rate above 100%, and growth rates needed to match a line shape. Medium.
Mostly direct table/chart lookups; main hurdle is Q2's hidden base (2015Q4 via 2016Q1 环比) with a near-miss trap, plus pie matching and a two-year projection.
Last 国考 passage with dense text; most items need multi-step derivations (export from 高技术 share, two increments, two-period share) plus pie matching and a computability item; time pressure.

One 28-row table with no year column (year inferred from event codes); almost every question needs grouping and summing many 5–6 digit entries. Arithmetic load and counting slips, not concepts, make it hard.
Two hard items: Q3 needs the concept target population = poor/incidence plus precise subtraction of large quotients; Q4 is a near-tie in average growth with base-year ambiguity. Rest straightforward.
Clear table and short text; data easy to find. Difficulty mainly Q4 (back out regional growth from share change and national growth) and Q1 average-growth formula; Q5 correct option is A. Moderate.

Pure dense text as the final 国考 passage; percentage-point phrases (比前三季度/比上年提高) must be decoded, Q3/Q4 have built-in lures, mixed growth needs base weights, and the derivability count requires judging all four items.

One clean table and two near-lookup items; difficulty comes from concept traps: absolute 变化量 with a negative value, per-100-household vs total ownership, and a weighted-average inference inside a 3-statement count question.
One table but many boundary calls (6985 vs 7000, 66.0 vs 66.6), a trend-line option format needing three yoy rates, and share×total mixing; no heavy traps, moderate overall.
文字+单柱图读数容易；难点为Q1隔年增速选项密集需精算、Q2需先求寿险比重再推意外险，其余为常规加和。
One dense 12-month × 8-column table. Q1 has a period-boundary trap, Q3 needs four base-period recoveries then cumulation, Q4 scans 12 growth pairs. Many lookups, moderate math.
Single dense paragraph with ~40 figures in mixed units (亿笔/万笔, 万亿元/亿元/亿美元), last 国考 passage; unit conversion (Q1), 92-day quarter (Q3) and a near-threshold 95% check (Q5).
Big 累计 table. Q3 needs differencing cumulative values into quarterly flows, Q5 needs increment reasoning across four enterprise types, Q1 carries the 是/多倍 trap. The arithmetic itself is light.
Single clean table with values and growth rates; all questions standard (share change, base period, mixing, increments, derivability). Moderate, some time cost in Q2/Q4.
Clean text and two labelled charts; mostly standard base and share-growth items. Difficulty concentrated in the count item (多3倍 trap plus two increment calculations) and the pie-matching item.
Pure-text bank report; nearly every item needs one or two base-period back-calculations. No single brutal item, but cumulative 基期 work and a 3-statement 错误 count make it moderately hard.
One stacked chart plus short text; hardest is a razor-thin growth-rate comparison (Q3) and a borderline share year (Q1). Others are standard formulas with magnitude decoys. Moderate overall.
Dense numeric text across several firms; Q2 hinges on reading '较2021年全年减少', Q5 needs base-period volume × price with unit conversion plus several near-threshold checks. Moderate.
One cumulative table; most items need differencing cumulative values; traps are cumulative vs quarter, partial-category sums and 多N倍 wording. Arithmetic heavy, concepts standard.
单张堆积柱图，数据少易读；难点为Q2两年增速紧贴10%需精算，Q4需转化为倍数判断，其余常规。
Text plus daily-average table plus import chart; must juggle daily averages vs totals, day counts, weighted growth and '多…倍' wording. Q5 very laborious; last-passage position adds time pressure.
Concept-heavy text (digital economy components, shares of GDP, implied GDP growth). Two share-change calculations with tight options and a multi-step inference question with sign traps.
Short text and one chart; traps dominate: 多几倍 after base-period, 万亿/亿 unit handling, '十三五' period knowledge, 万元 vs 60万. Calculations themselves are light.
Long dense text; nearly every item is base-period work (two-base growth, increments with negatives, −76% base, surplus) with current-year-value traps; final 国考 passage under heavy time pressure.

Three charts plus text; mostly lookups and sums, but Q1 has 0.01-spaced options with base-period/unit trap, and the inference question needs a running cumulative sum to expose the 'December first' trap.
Dense single-block text covering seven industries; calculations are one-step, but each item hides a reading trap (高出/放缓/减亏 direction, profit vs revenue growth, derivability). Moderate GK passage.

Text-only, with GDP contributions and investment shares. The pie-chart increment item (visual angles, misleading 拉动 ratios) and mixed-share reasoning are the hard points; Q1 and Q3 are near-free. Medium.
Text + table + 100% bar + combo chart. Q2 multiplies two shares where 2017 and 2020 differ by <1%, Q4 needs share-adjusted growth; the rest are reading/subtraction. Moderate.
Moderate. Clean text, standard formulas: two-year base, reverse mixed growth, base ratio with distant options, unit-price change. 综合 has unit and 倍数 wording traps but the correct option is easy.

Short text plus one bar chart; standard items. Main traps: monthly per-capita spending (÷12, wrong base figure), 2020 社零 needing base-year 餐饮 and previous-year share, and increment work for the line-shape item.
Large 11-month table where every item needs subtractions or a back-calculated 2020 base. Traps: ÷2 in Q1 and novel line-chart matching; arithmetic simple, options mostly far apart.
Text-only with many 万元/亿元 figures and both 环比/同比 rates; must pick the right rate, convert units and compute fairly precise products; Q5 option D sits at 49% vs 50%.
Two neat tables. Q1 stacks base-period and 多几倍 traps; Q3–Q4 use standard share/average rules; Q5 needs monthly rather than the printed cumulative shares. Moderate overall.
Routine ranking, base-ratio and chart-increment items, but a 十三五 base-year trap and a how-many item where all three hold, ③ needing multi-step back-calculation of 累计结存 via the 结存 note.
Two tables with extreme growth rates (1067%, 2143%) inviting 倍数 errors; the 能推出 item packs an absolute-value trap and a +1 trap; other items are short calculations.
Text plus one dual-axis monthly chart; all standard tools (隔年基期, 比重差, 环比, 倍数). Main risks: the 多多少倍 trap and stopping at a one-step base. Q5 is a direct addition. Medium.
Short text plus a single bar chart; Q1–Q2 are routine. The difficulty sits in mixed growth, a projection with a year-span trap, and a four-statement Q5 with a planted base-period trap. Medium.
Clean bar chart and 8x10 table with easy arithmetic; difficulty from traps: Q1 requires inferring the three provinces missing from the table, Q4 has the 9-vs-10 interval trap.
Very dense text of week-on-week, year-on-year and pp changes. Q4 chains a base period with the ILI% definition under close options; judgement needs several base-period calcs near thresholds.
Text plus two clean charts; traps rather than heavy computation: forgetting 2019 in the average, 多几倍, a zero-answer count. The comprehensive item resolves by chart reading. Moderate.
One big 33-row table; Q1–Q2 trivial. Difficulty sits in Q5: three statements all false with near-threshold values and an error-prone count, plus tiny-rate comparison in Q4.
Two clean bar-line charts with small arithmetic. Difficulty comes from ranking close per-unit values and a count needing a base-period 2016 decrease; other items are routine. Medium.
Dense four-paragraph text mixing increments and rates. Needs the two-year-average concept, growth from increments and a base-period share; moderate precision in Q2 and Q4, otherwise routine.
单表数据清晰，Q1/Q4一眼可判；难点在累计与当月拆分的基期量、增长量(Q3符号/漏除陷阱)及Q5单位与范围陷阱。

Quarterly bar chart with only odd quarters labeled; questions need summing many bars (annual totals, 2012 rural 9788 near 10000). Arithmetic simple and options coarse; misassigning quarters is the main risk.
Text plus two dual-axis charts with 亩/公顷 unit traps. Q2 needs the constant-land-area idea, Q4 legend matching, Q5 several growth checks including derived per-wetland area. Moderate.
Cross-chart totals (882, 12950) must be summed before shares; a near-threshold 苏州 case, a subtract-listed trap, and a five-slice pie judgement.
Dense text only, with '增速扩大X个百分点' two-step back-outs, two different national rates (industry vs paper) and '多…倍' wording. Traps rather than heavy arithmetic; last passage.
Three charts (bars, three pies, top-10) to cross-reference. The calculations are standard (product difference, base period, base share), but Q1 needs precision and Q5 has a unit trap. Medium.
Compact table with paired quantity/amount growths; Q1-Q4 routine. Q5 combines the '高N倍' wording trap with a weighted mixed-growth check, where most errors occur.
Labelled bar and line charts make reading easy. Moderate traps: unit conversion to 万亿, product growth 140% vs 240%, '最慢' with negatives, and a bar-shape match needing several subtractions.
No conceptual traps; difficulty is volume: dozens of additions across two stacked bar charts, close cases (Aug, Dec), and screening increments of four series.
Short clean text; mostly direct share, base and subtraction. Points lost on a 0.2%-apart option pair, the tight 4.97 vs 5 check, and a sign trap (non-fiber ports actually fell).
Readable text and a small table; most items direct. The real hurdle is the note-based 旅客周转量 increment; the 能推出 item has a tight 5% trap but an easily verified correct option.
One clean table, no text. Mostly sums and differences; difficulty is the close options in Q1 and the two-year share-rise screening in Q5. Medium-easy apart from the time cost.
Bar-line chart plus 13-row table with mixed units (万个 vs 个); many additions (type totals, full sum) and an interval-count trap in 年均增量. Moderate overall.
Three-part material (text, 14-row table, two charts) is dense. Q2 is a tedious 14-row ratio count with a borderline reversed row; Q5 has a near-threshold one-fifth statement. Other three are routine.
Text, pie and table but lookups are simple. Difficulty concentrated in Q4 (seeing the table sums to the 2.6% non-一类 share) and the count question's 9.1% 三+四类 trap.
Single clean bar chart; difficulty comes from tedium (nine-year sum, nine near-0.9 ratios) rather than concepts. Q1 cumulative back-out and Q4 borderline ratios are the main error points.
Online-pharmacy data must be derived as total minus physical; average-increment base ambiguity and 2013 back-calculation traps; Q5 needs several derived series.

Clean table; two trivial items. Harder: a base-period difference with a current-year trap, the 25% month-vs-average insight with tight margins, and a 能推出 item with exact-number reversal and 是/多倍 traps.

No easy item: growth-rate wording, four base-period values for a line chart, increment differences and quarter-share reasoning from cumulative growth. Last passage, so time pressure compounds the difficulty.
Long pure-text passage of dates and deviations, last passage of the paper (time pressure). Arithmetic simple but deviation-direction, 高出-vs-是 and calendar-count traps.
Two dense monthly charts with a combined 1–2月 bar; several items need back-calculating prior-year months from yoy rates, mixed-growth reasoning with rounded totals, and sign/direction traps.
两张排名表结构清晰，题型常规；陷阱为现期值选项及两榜机场名匹配，选错题需逐项核验。
One labeled bar-line chart; most items easy (sum, mixing, increments). Q3 hides July 2023 behind the 2024 growth rate, a classic trap, and Q5 has a same-year ratio trap.
Text relationship chains (低20.9%, 高22.7%) are the crux: Q3 and Q4 punish multiplying instead of dividing. Other items are one-step and the table judgment is quick. Medium.
Long fiscal text, but questions are standard (mixed growth, increments, 环比 rates, base period). The four-statement counting question with a near-threshold item (118 vs 120) is the main difficulty.
Two dual-axis charts with all values labelled and no real traps; effort is in Q3's five yield checks (answer 'all') and Q5's multi-series increments. Easy-to-medium for GK.
Simple table and short text; difficulty is conceptual (增速 vs 百分点, 新登记−注销=净增) plus a Q5 whose right answer is a loose '约2倍' amid direction and 30%-threshold traps.

Last passage: two monthly charts with extreme growth rates (hundreds of %). Base-period ratios, a hidden January MoM trap and a calculation-heavy 错误 statement question; easy to misuse 1+r or run out of time.
Three-page text demands locating data; arithmetic is simple, but options are tightly spaced (Q1, Q2) and wording traps (略降, 收窄, 加快) govern prior-month derivations.
Easy-moderate: one clean table plus three totals, options mostly far apart. Only Q4 (deriving world GDP, ‰ magnitude) and the four-statement judgement need care; no growth-rate algebra.
Chart plus nine-row table; no deep traps but volume: nine growth checks with several near 5%, month counting, and a population back-out via 普及率. Moderate.
Long text with many parallel numbers plus a dense 15-row table; classic traps ('多4倍', 4 vs 5 intervals, negative-growth share change); last passage of the paper.
Long text with many look-alike figures (6月 vs 上半年, 进/出口, 环比/同比); calculations simple, but the 15-point and 400-ton boundaries and 环比-vs-同比 reasoning cost some users.

Survey percentages in two pies; arithmetic trivial, but three logic items (rounding/unknown range, pigeonhole overlap, 容斥 inference) plus a 多几倍 wording trap; unfamiliar reasoning, not computation, costs points.
Text plus two labeled bar charts; standard 基期, 增量, 比重变化 items with fair options. Effort concentrated in Q4's December back-out and Q5's growth-trend matching (≈9 growth rates). Medium.
Mixed text plus chart with total/province/city levels; formula-derivation question and trend-matching statement need careful algebra and many half-year ratios, though elimination helps.
Short text plus one combo chart; straightforward growth comparisons and share products; only the bar-chart matching needs five multiplications. Moderate-easy.
Text-only but figures clearly labelled; standard base-period, mixing and base-period-share calculations. Main risk is Q5's 多2倍 trap and unknowable item. Moderate-easy.

Small clean table, ratio and sum work with wide options. Traps: 含村社区 requires adding two rows, first year exceeding 150 under constant increment, matching bar heights to increments across four indicators.

Country-share text plus 6-year table. Q1, Q2, Q4 all require combining export and import bases (unit conversion, weighted average, cross-base comparison) where naive percentage comparison misleads. Rest routine. Moderate.
Short text plus small table; mostly lookups and one-step calculations with spread options. Only Q5 (unit conversion with a 10× trap) and the increment ratio need care. Fairly easy.

Easy-to-locate text data; mostly one- or two-step base-period and ratio work with forgiving options. Only the 能够推出 item (sign wording '较…低', share-vs-count reasoning, part-vs-whole growth) needs real effort.

Cumulative-only table forces de-cumulation, but Q1–Q4 options are robust even to naive reading. Q5 is the killer: correct B needs share-based 环比 reasoning while C is a strong trap (forgetting 2022Q2).
Two clean charts; most items single-step. Main pitfalls: base-year choice in Q2 (both 6.3 and 6.9 offered) and nominal vs real growth; Q5 needs four yearly nominal growths.
Survey percentages scattered in text with chained '高/低…个百分点' relations, an unusual 容斥 minimum-overlap item and a precision-sensitive population product; last passage of the paper adds time pressure.
Last passage with two dense 11×8 tables: heavy locating and scanning, two-share precision, and a final item stacked with near-miss traps (首次超过 year, 5% threshold, 万 vs 亿). Time pressure dominates.

Mostly easy text reads plus one conceptual killer: inferring 环比-vs-last-year from a 同比 line (count months where 同比 drops). 隔年基期 needs 回落 conversion; 综合 needs 利润率 definition. Pie data make base-share trivial.

Four near-identical paragraphs (national vs 重点, all vs export) invite mis-location; two-base and share-direction logic; arithmetic light. Last 国考 passage, so time-pressure guessing depresses every item.
Clean chart plus table, all labelled, wide option spacing; mostly sums and simple ratios. Only the novel line-shape question needs five divisions. Easy-to-moderate for a GK passage.

Two clean bar charts; work is mostly subtraction/division with well-separated options. Harder spots: deriving national totals from market shares (Q2) and building the H2 series for the chart match (Q5).
Easy chart and short text. Difficulty sits in Q4 (interval growth with near-identical options) and Q5, where all four statements are close-threshold checks and the false one misses by 0.2%.

Easy-moderate. Two clearly labeled stacked bar charts; questions are direct share changes, sums and comparisons. Effort is reading many bar labels and computing increments for the trend chart, not tricky formulas.
长表但定位简单，计算多为方向判断或简单除法；主要失分在Q5增加值/总产值概念陷阱与Q4混合增速端点。

Stacked bars with a data table; first three items simple. Monthly catch-up modelling and matching an increment line to a negative-increment series are unusual; last 国考 passage, so heavy time-pressure guessing.
Small clean table with easy arithmetic, but two novel formats: an ambiguous 'maximum per launch' pigeonhole item and a pie-chart matching item requiring four years of shares.
一表一段文字，计算量小，多可用增速比较或排除；考点为利润前三识别陷阱和饼图细节辨析，整体中等偏易。
Single clean bar+line chart with labeled values; mostly lookups, sums, differences. Only the 2025 projection (Q5) is multi-step; 国考 population keeps even easy items in the 70s.
Text-only city economy, mostly one-step reading. Only Q3 (two-stage period subtraction plus 增速提高 wording) and the 80% boundary in Q5 need care. Easiest of this set.
Single clean table; lookups, shares and sums with well-separated options. Minor traps (2016 outside range, 十三五 years) and a pie to match. Fairly easy despite the M3 position.
Quarter-vs-March growth table testing standard techniques (interval base period, mixed-growth direction, share-direction rule). Routine for trained users; few traps, options reasonably far apart.

Clear table plus monthly bars; first passage of 地市级. Needs bases from increments, many monthly differences to match a polyline, quarter sums; 不能推出 resolved by spotting 官网's high 举报 share. Moderate-easy.

Easy-moderate. Data plainly stated; one multiplication, qualitative mixed growth, wide-band base share, obvious share-change direction. Only the ratio-trend chart needs four divisions. Few traps; options well separated.
Text, bar chart and table but data well labeled; Q4 needs the weighted-average (population ratio) insight and Q3 a base-period difference; other items are visual comparisons.
Short text plus small table, data easy to find; mostly direct comparisons. Only Q1 close options and the bar-chart sign check need care. Easy-to-moderate.
Final 国考副省级 passage: four dense paragraphs of look-alike monthly/annual figures; Jan values must be derived as 1-2月 minus Feb (Q1, Q5). Calculations otherwise standard share change and base period.
Text-only but orderly; one-step formulas with spread options and obvious listed traps (同比 vs 环比, current vs base). Only the three-statement count question needs real work.
Simple charts and calculations; the one real trap is Q4, where both base-year conventions for the 2016–2021 average increment appear as options.
Long multi-topic text plus a seven-year table; Q1 hides population in per-capita road area, Q5 needs a second difference with a first-difference trap. Last passage adds time pressure. Hard.
Three quick chart items, but Q4 needs the 结余率 definition and a precise two-step growth projection with tight options, and Q5 mixes a near-flat ratio comparison with a missing-data trap.
Organized table and chart; lookups and pattern matching are easy, but two range questions sit right on boundaries (10.87 vs 10.9, 1.996 vs 2.0) and need precise calculation.
Very long two-page text with look-alike figures (入境 vs 入境过夜, 人次 vs 花费); locating data is the main cost. Arithmetic mostly simple except Q3 precision and Q2 base period.
Single tidy chart-table; two items are visual matching and two are qualitative counting. Only Q1 (two base-periods) and Q3 need real arithmetic, with spread options. Relatively easy.
Single tidy table; most items are one-step. The hard point is Q1's period-convention trap where all four options match different base/interval choices; Q5 has a near-threshold 26% check.
Text-only and mostly one-step; main hurdles are the residual mixed growth (Q2), a 亿/万 unit conversion, and derivability logic in Q5.

Dense 3-crop cost table, but questions are mostly one-step lookups/base-period with robust options. Only Q3 needs the 产值=亩产×价格 insight with near-equal 稻谷 rates. Column-choice traps mild. Fairly easy for 国考.

Clean table + labeled bar chart. Four questions are sums/threshold counts with one borderline item each; only Q5 (line-shape choice) needs five divisions and a fine 2021-vs-2022 comparison. Easy-moderate.
Easy first 国考 passage: short text plus one bar/line chart, mostly lookups and single base-period steps; only traps are current-vs-base difference in Q1 and chart-matching of increments in Q4.
Clearly labeled stacked bars; Q1 needs the insight that the total is two components with opposite-sign base-period increments. Others are routine growth, count and projection items with mild traps.

Labeled chart plus short text; plain calculations with mostly well-separated options. Only snags: the unlabeled 2021 primary-industry bar and a four-statement 正确 item needing several subtractions. Easy opening passage.
Long text but each item maps to clearly stated numbers; difficulty concentrated in Q4 (intensity to revenue growth) and close options in Q3; Q5 answerable directly.

Last passage. Cumulative-value chart forces monthly differencing and a Jan–Feb base period; graph matching with a cumulative trap; DOU text clause easy to misread. Every item is multi-step or conceptual.
Short text plus one clean bar chart; mostly single base-period or subtraction steps. Only Q4 (per-capita growth from GDP and population growth, then the increment) needs a formula.

One dense paragraph but every figure is explicit. Q1, Q2 trivial; Q5 statements mostly direct. Difficulty sits in Q3 share change (two base-period values, close options) and Q4 rate-direction reasoning. Easy-moderate.
Text-only, data scattered over paragraphs; need to derive industry total and average growth (15.2-1.9). Arithmetic light, but last-passage time pressure plus denominator and sign traps.
Clean single chart; most items are subtraction or counting. Harder spots: population via 普及率 with close options and the judgment item's period-base and percentage-point-direction traps.
Single clean table, small calculations. Mild traps only: ÷4 vs ÷5 years in Q1 and two close growth rates in Q2; judgement answer visible at a glance.

Hard. Text packed with shares and percentage-point changes; reverse-derive total trade growth from share change, base-year convention with stacked bars, derivability judgment; anchored traps everywhere; last passage under time pressure.
Two 12-month charts; Q1 is a precision mixed-growth trap (15.2 vs 15.6), Q3 an interval-count trap, Q5 three laborious counting/increment statements before the true D. Final passage, time-pressed.
Two tidy tables; standard 基期, 比重变化 and 混合增长 formulas with generous options. Moderate effort only in the increment-pattern chart and the mixed-growth fill-in; no heavy traps.
Plain integer table with easy arithmetic, but it is the final 国考副省级 passage (time pressure, guessing) and Q4/Q5 require tedious scanning of many cells; Q2 needs five-year-plan years.
短文字+一表，以加和、简单除法为主，唯一多步为Q1累计减当月；陷阱(1620、8747.9)显眼，整体偏易。
文字+双轴图；Q1、Q2需基期与比重联立且陷阱齐全，Q5三项需精算、D极度临界并涉年均口径，处末篇。
Mostly easy table lookups; the opener hides an unstated identity (province-level = total − regions) and the judgment item needs a close growth comparison plus counting categories.
Two easy lookups; difficulty comes from the 2013 increment hidden in a growth rate, a five-year compound projection, and an inference question packed with period/average traps.
Combo chart of cumulative bars and two cumulative growth lines; cumulative→quarterly traps in Q3 and Q5, units mixing 亿 and 万亿, a two-year base calculation; last passage of the 地市级 paper.
Two clean tables with explicit growth figures; mostly one-step base-period work. Only Q3's threshold comparison and Q5's 0.88-vs-1亿 precision need care. Easy-medium.
Dense text but questions mostly direct; difficulty concentrates in the two-year base period with a derived prior growth rate and the close 101-vs-100 statement.
Short text plus stacked-bar table; standard ratio and average-growth work. Q4 projection with a negative 同城 increment and Q5 near-threshold checks are the hard parts.
Clean single table with easy lookups; real difficulty only in Q1's near-tie of increments and Q5's several multi-number sums.
Dense but clean numeric table; standard base period, share and count. Q4 needs increment estimates across many provinces to find max and min; Q5 needs three subtractions before pie matching.
Simple chart and text; sums and single base-periods with spread options. Only Q4's near-1000 ratio and Q5's look-alike line options need care. Easy passage.
Totals are given only for 2022 and must be backed out through a growth-rate chain; traps around base years and simple averages of rates; Q5 pie matching is laborious estimation.
Text plus combo chart. Close options in Q1 (2017 trap), boundary check in the GDP count, and razor-thin 40.1% / 0.975 in judgement; other items easy.
纯文字材料数据密集需反复定位；年均增长年限、'多几倍'、数字颠倒等陷阱多，Q5需两期比重计算，且为末篇时间紧。

Easy park table: single divisions, a count, locating a province figure. Mild traps only—万公顷 conversion, mismatching 浙江/江苏 numbers, 南京's outsized average in 综合. Little real calculation; low-tier difficulty for 国考.
Clean table plus bar chart, all data easy to locate; only Q1 unit conversion and Q3 two-year projection need care. Easiest passage of the set.
Rates-of-rates data: chart plus small size table, few numbers. Lookups easy; difficulty from relative growth of a percentage with borderline thresholds (Q3) and the computation-heavy Q5.
Big 17×7 table invites misreading, but calculations are simple; only Q4's two base periods with sign flip and the row-by-row scans in Q3/Q5 cost time.

Moderate-hard. Hidden quantity by subtraction, base-year convention with summed bars, half-year base plus monthly average, time-heavy growth-trend matching with a near-miss option; last-passage position adds pressure.

Last passage. Simple data but trap-laden: 多几倍 with 1-apart options, close base-period difference, year-base convention for average growth, and an ambiguous line-chart item (absolute vs signed change).
Text-only but each question is one standard operation. Q3 two-part base-period with a 2023-value trap and Q5 wording traps (period mismatch, 增长n倍) are the main pitfalls. Easy-moderate.

Long dense text with many similar categories, but each question is one standard formula (growth amount, per-capita, share, average-growth rule). Close options demand precision; Q5 has 同比/环比 and 多倍 wording traps.
Simple text plus two bar charts; mostly one-step. Close options in Q1 and averaging ten values / summing extremes in the inference question are the only time sinks.
Last passage, text plus table. Q1 needs a back-out of base share and base total; the final item hinges on bound logic with a strong distractor (province total mistaken for SUV count).
Pure dense text but every quantity explicit. Mixed growth for national 单产, simple base from increment and rate, signed residual sum. 不能推出 answer directly contradicted by text. Moderate-easy overall.

Clean table and one text paragraph; most items are lookups or one-step growth. Difficulty concentrated in Q4 base-year convention (2012 vs 2013 flips the answer) and Q5 '多2倍多' wording plus an 8-number sum.
Easy overall: big but clean 15-city table, mostly lookups and simple sums with well-spaced options. Only the judgment item takes real scanning and one close average comparison.
Last passage. Dense text plus H1/Q1 table forces quarter subtraction and base-period work; 多多少倍 trap, 拉动 concept and four-statement check all demand precise reading. Hardest of set.
All dense text with many similar 1-7月 versus 7月 figures; base-period share and cumulative subtraction require locating the right pairs, but options are reasonably spaced.
Small clean table, mostly one-step lookups or ratios with well-separated options; mild traps only (growth formula direction, 80% threshold near 山东, units in Q4). Easy passage.

Clean ten-year table with easy lookups. Difficulty concentrated in one knife-edge average (100.27 vs 100) needing exact addition and a curve-shape match hinging on the small 2018 dip. 不能推出 is obvious.

Final passage built on unit price (amount/quantity) across two charts: repeated divisions, a 百万美元/万吨 unit conversion, price-growth comparisons and a range trap in Q5. Calculation-heavy under end-of-test time pressure.
Short text, mostly one-step base period and share with far options. Only the 30%-female reverse share and spotting the averaged-regional-growth trap need thought.

Last passage, text dense with crop figures: base derivation with mixed signs, area growth from increments, a 1.9% threshold equal to the naive difference, and tight comparisons (0.54 vs 0.60, 1314 vs 1341).
Three pages of text but clearly labeled data and simple arithmetic; only Q3 (percentage-point wording) and Q5 (mixed-growth logic trap) need real thought.

Long dense text of look-alike indicators; every item needs locating the right sentence plus multi-step reasoning (contribution rate, totals from shares, prior-year share), with unit and monthly-average traps.
Short text and a simple bar-line chart; Q1–Q4 are one-step. Last passage of the paper, so time pressure; the correct judgement D is a conceptual bound many hesitate on.
Dense one-paragraph text with many growth rates, but most questions are one-step. Difficulty lies in the algebraic formula item and the averaged-growth trap in Q5. Easy-medium.
Pure text but numbers are clearly labeled; Q1-Q2 trivial, Q4 is reading care. Effort concentrated in the Q3 counterfactual and Q5 with four computations including a projection.
Short text plus small table; most items one-step. Q2 needs the insight amount = users x per-capita spend; Q5 hinges on '增长N倍' and boundary '超' wording. Last passage of the paper.
Clear chart and small table; standard averages and growth counts with a couple of close calls. The judgment item needs annual-minus-half-year derivation but yields to elimination.
Last passage. Conceptual: reverse-deriving GDP growth from share change, plus a count item with a near-threshold increment, an equal-growth share trap and 三新-vs-GDP share confusion.
Clean table with clear labels; four items are one-step. Only Q3's close 环比-growth comparison (国际 route) needs precision; Q5 requires remembering the December base.
One clean table; standard base-period, mixed-growth and ratio-direction tasks. Traps: 民航 in 万吨 and close rail/water increments. Moderate-easy.
Several charts (yearly bars, province and city rankings) but each item uses one or two labeled values; pitfalls are the 多几倍 wording and cross-chart city/province matching in Q5. Easy-moderate.

Single clean table with easy lookup; questions are standard (年均增长量, product growth, projection, line shape). Difficulty mostly from last-passage time pressure and boundary traps (8.08 years, 十三五 range).

Dense 10×4 table plus share line; requires total×share products, translating '2倍以上' into a 2/3 share threshold with near-boundary values, growth-trend shape matching, and a 综合 with near-threshold and 倍数-wording traps.

Five dense text paragraphs, no tables. Average-per-show change needs two base periods plus 亿/万→元 conversion; count-type 推出 needs data-availability judgments for four statements. Remaining items are direct shares and rates.
Last passage. Large table with missing cells: derive missing growth via total minus part, mixed-growth ratio with reversed trap, sign handling with negative rates; rest are lookups.
Clean charts; four items are lookups or simple growth. Difficulty lies only in the final count-the-wrong-statements item with a near-tie year and subjective '大体一致' wording.
Mostly straightforward lookups; traps are 产值 vs 增加值 in the share change, base-period bar-chart matching (2021 vs 2022 heights) and 万吨→亿斤 conversion.
Dense text plus table but questions mostly single-step; only the base-period share and MoM-vs-YoY trap need care. Inference question largely eliminated by 'no data' logic.
Single well-organized table; all questions are lookups, sums or simple shares with wide option gaps. Mild traps: row scope in Q1; Q5 needs several checks.
Three charts; Q3–Q4 back out total market from mobile share, Q2 has a 棋牌/卡牌 label trap, Q5 hinges on 年均 base-year convention near a threshold. Last passage.
Clean table and short text; lookups, subtractions and one-step ratios with spread options. Only the 亿吨 unit in the sum-growth item needs care. Easy first passage.
Small clean table plus bar/line chart; short calculations with elimination shortcuts. Only the 十三五 base-year/÷5 lure is notable; an easy passage.
Short text with every figure given; three near-lookup items. Only Q1 (base-year R&D plus prior intensity) and Q5 (two increments) need real work. Clearly easy.
Last passage; mostly one-step calculations, but share-change reasoning (Q2) and the per-item revenue mixed-growth judgement in the final question trip weaker candidates.
Simple single table, but traps cluster: 十三五 base year and near-miss year in Q2, two '多…倍' traps; last-passage position adds time pressure.

Short text plus small table; Q1-Q4 routine (base period, interval growth, share comparison, chart shape). Difficulty concentrated in Q5, where B's negative-growth comparison distracts from the true C.
Table of cumulative Q1/H1 values forces repeated Q2-by-subtraction; cumulative-growth logic in Q5. Numbers are clean and options reasonably apart, so moderate.
Bar chart + 10-year price table; questions are single-step lookups/growths with clear options. Only Q5 needs several year-on-year egg-price growths (2018 vs 2021). Easy.
Large dense table (7 periods × 5 indicators); 是/多倍 trap, a 能推出 item whose true option needs mixed-growth inference while a false one matches the numbers exactly, plus last-passage time pressure.
Last passage with one bar-line chart. Concepts (share vs growth, the 十三五 span) and a near-threshold projection make it moderately tricky; arithmetic is light, but time pressure lowers accuracy.
Clean text plus a labeled bar chart; every item is a lookup or a one-step increment/growth comparison with well-separated options. Only the pie-chart match takes real work. Easy.
Single chart, but every item mixes averages and growth. Q1 monthly-per-store unit trap, Q3 close options, Q5 年均 convention, iteration and average-growth checks; last-passage time pressure.

Easy: short text, small table, labeled bars. Direct shares, a growth comparison with a clear winner, pie recognition, per-activity averages; only 综合 needs one base-period increment and a ratio-direction check.
Dense text, but most items need one or two simple steps with spaced options; mild lures (2022 vs 2013 shares, 10/9). Real difficulty only in the derivability count, plus last-passage time pressure.
Single static table without growth rates; difficulty is volume (ten-item threshold count) and one near-boundary ratio. Other items are direct sums or differences with spaced options.
Two clean labeled bar-line charts and simple one-step calculations; only Q5 carries a strong unit trap. Content is easy, but as the last passage time pressure and guessing pull accuracy down.
Unusual 当月/累计/占比 table; one item needs the share-change insight for cumulative vs monthly growth and the count item hinges on 亿元/万件 conversion. Last passage under time pressure.
First three items are quick lookups or one division; difficulty is the 2021 back-calculation of shares and amount and a judgment item mixing similar shares (风光 vs all renewables).
Two charts and short text with easy numbers; difficulty centres on Q3's ratio-vs-percentage-point trap for growth ranking and Q1's increment line needing one base-period. Last passage of the paper.
Short text plus ranked table; arithmetic trivial (subtractions, one base-period). Friction only from matching reordered countries across years, typos, and last-passage time pressure.

Text + bar chart + 16-row table (chart/table taken from unlisted crop p3), yet questions are routine: one two-period share, simple bar differences, obvious comparisons. Only Q5 needs mixed-growth reasoning and scope care.
Text plus bar chart; Q1, Q2, Q5 quick, but Q3 and Q4 combine shares from different years with chart values. Last-passage position lowers rates.

Moderate: average-distance growth logic (Q1–Q2), sorting negative growth rates, and a statement question needing an exact six-number sum plus a 年均 convention lure. Last passage, so time pressure trims accuracy.
Content easy: one labeled bar chart and short text, mostly subtraction. Only the hidden non-wood figure and the line-shape match need care. Last passage, so time pressure lowers accuracy.
Short text plus one combo chart; each question is one standard operation (share, base-period, mixed growth, average) with well-separated options. Q4's five divisions are the only real work. Easy.

Clean labeled bar charts; difficulty is volume, not depth. Q3's three-step December estimate and Q1's near-threshold/negative growth counting are the main traps; last-passage position adds time pressure.

Clean text, table and labeled bar chart; mostly one-step calculations with well-separated options. Only the ÷12 monthly lure and 2012-base subtraction; difficulty is mainly last-passage time pressure in 国考.
Moderate. Short text plus one bar-line chart. Two easy items; others hinge on denominator choice, deriving 2018 from 2019 growth, and separating 增量 from 增速 in the trend chart. Last-passage position.
One sorted table of three-digit values; four questions are pure lookups or tiny sums. Only Q5's close decline-rate comparison and counting traps need care. Very easy passage.
Easy passage: direct lookups and wide option gaps; only Q1 needs two base-period increments.

Large table plus two bar charts, but every question is a single sum or ratio with spread options; tail-digit tricks work. Only mild traps (资助率 definition, close 47-48% ratios); last-passage time pressure.
Two clean tables; standard share, increment and trend calculations with well-separated options. Only the implied exchange-rate conversion in Q4 adds real work. Easy passage.
Long material yet clean table and chart; most items are lookups or single ratios with an obvious winner. Only Q5 requires several 2015 back-calculations; slight last-passage pressure.

Mostly direct data and standard concepts; difficulty from deriving 2023 60-64 via text subtraction, share-vs-growth logic, and a chart-shape item needing differences. Last passage of the paper adds time pressure.
Simple monthly table; easy sum and ratio items, but a precise mixed-growth item with close options and a six-ratio line-shape item eat time in the last passage.
Single monthly chart; operations are simple but each item carries a period/count trap (include June, n−1 intervals, merged 1-2月) and Q3 needs a two-base 环比. Final passage of the 副省级 paper.
Short text with one-step calculations and well-separated options; only mild traps (annual average vs single-year growth, direction of '60%以上').
文字+单柱图，多为直接计算；Q3现期/基期比重陷阱、Q5需算四年增速选折线稍耗时，末篇有时间压力。
Plain text, mostly direct growth/base items. Only the contribution-rate item (coal 增长14.2倍, answer above 100%, %-misreading trap) and a 回落-direction sign trap bite; some last-passage time pressure.
Two clear bar charts with all values labelled; questions are sums, ranks and simple ratios with wide options. Only Q5 combines both charts. Easy passage.
Easy: clear chart plus text, mostly lookups and coarse estimation with far-apart options. Only the five-year sum and the constant-increment projection need care.
Simple monthly table. Difficulty only from unit conversion with a borderline April price (Q4), an inverted-ratio trap (Q2) and a wrong-year ratio trap (Q5-C). Last-position time pressure.
Easy data: two simple bar charts plus short text. Only Q1 (base-period distance) and Q5 (tight threshold, 增速放缓 and unit traps) need care. Last-position time pressure is the main drag.
